candidate: Canonical M27 trained with a straight-through hard-projector endpoint contract
pain_point: Training physics sees unprojected geometry while deployment applies a hard projector and refiner. M42 showed head-level internal consistency can make legalization worse.
mechanism: During training only, pass the final x0 value through four hard-projector iterations. Physics, bbox and decode diagnostics use the projected value while gradients pass to the raw x0 through a straight-through identity.
target_boundary: Only fixed/preplaced/MIB conditions may read target_latent. Free-block target positions remain unused by the projector.
promotion_gate: Joint legalized cost and V_rel improvement with feasibility 1.0 and no legalizer rung/solve escalation.
falsification: Projector-aware training changes the inference path, violates target-conditioned constraints, or either primary endpoint metric regresses.

training_result.decision: Reject full-strength hard-projector values. They leave the x0 trust region and destabilize training.
